versions.changelog: Reroute parked ClawMart paid CTA to free PhantomWorks ClawHub tools and update homepage metadata

- Updated ClawMart listing link in metadata and throughout documentation to new multi-platform optimizer URL.
- Adjusted all references to the premium ClawMart version with the updated listing name and link.
- No changes to skill features or usage instructions.

- Updated ClawMart homepage URL and links to point to the new Listing Rewriter for Cross-Border Sellers on ClawMart.
- Added information about expanded multi-platform support (Amazon, Etsy, Shopify, eBay, TikTok Shop) available through ClawMart.
- Highlighted new features: cultural adaptation scoring, platform-specific formatting, and a confidence meter for native-level English.
- Revised "Want More?" section to focus on ClawMart offering instead of the previous ListingBridge link.

- Initial release of ListingBridge Free Optimizer.
- Transforms Chinese product info into polished English Amazon listings (title, 5 bullets, description).
- Designed for cross-border, non-native English sellers—no direct/CN-style translation.
- Supports both raw Chinese input and “improve my English draft” use cases.
- Outputs benefit-first copy, optimized for Western buyers.
- Includes links and info for bulk and multi-platform tools via ListingBridge.
